title: Selection-tool drag-move inconsistently snaps shape back to original position (cannot move)
description:
FIXED. Root cause: Shell.tsx drag handlers built the next doc from the React-subscribed `doc` snapshot (refreshes only on next render) instead of the live store present. During fast/multi-event drags, multiple onShapeMove(dx,dy) deltas fired against the SAME stale closure doc within one render frame, each rebuilding from the original base position + only the latest re-baselined delta -> accumulated movement discarded -> snap-back. commitDrag had the same defect on mouse-up.

Fix (Shell.tsx only): added withTimelineLive() that sources the base from documentStore.getState().history.present (scene- and symbol-aware, reusing the pure withSceneTimeline/withSymbolTimeline store helpers). handleShapeMove now (a) records the pre-drag snapshot from the live present and (b) builds via withTimelineLive so each delta accumulates on the freshest store state. handleShapeMoveEnd commits documentStore.getState().history.present as the final position. StageArea incremental-delta + re-baseline contract unchanged.

Test: packages/authoring-ui/src/__tests__/selectionDragCommit.test.ts — deterministic store-handler-level repro of the no-render-flush race. Dispatches 5x (+10,+10) deltas back-to-back with NO snapshot refresh, then commits. STALE-snapshot source loses deltas (snaps back to origin); LIVE store-present source accumulates to +50,+50, commits the full move, persists across a re-render, and records exactly one undo step.

VERIFY: pnpm --filter './packages/**' build green. pnpm --filter @flash/authoring-ui run test --run = 668 passed (46 files), incl. 2 new. No new failures.
